detail.overview: Compare Favourite NVR2108HS-8P-I2 8 Channel Compact 1U 8PoE 1HDD WizSense Network Video Recorder Key Points • Max. 144/144/72 Mbps Incoming/Recording/Outgoing Bandwidth • Max. Decoding Capability: 6 × 1080p@30 fps • IP Cameras Resolution Up to 12 MP • 1 Bay. Each HDD Storage Capacity Up to 10TB • AI by Recorder: 1-ch Face Detection and Recognition, 4-ch SMD, 1-ch Perimeter Protection Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.AI by Camera: Face detection; face recognition; perimeter protection; SMD Plus
General.AI by Device: Face detection; face recognition; perimeter protection; SMD Plus
General.Face Attributes: 6 attibutes: Gender; age group (6); glasses; expressions (8); mouth mask; beard
General.Face Database Capacity: Up to 10 face databases with 5,000 images
General.SMD Plus by Camera: 6-channel SMD Plus (AI by camera): Detects tripwire and intrustion of human or vehicle; filters false alarms caused by leaves, raindrops and change of brightness away
General.Network Bandwidth: AI off: Access: 144 Mbps; Storage: 144 Mbps; Forward: 72 Mbps AI on: Access: 72 Mbps; Storage: 72 Mbps; Forward: 36 Mbps
General.Decoding Capability: AI disabled: 1-channel 12MP@30 fps; 1-channel 8MP@30 fps; 2-channel 5MP@30 fps; 3-channel 4MP@30 fps; 6-channel 1080p@30 fps AI enabled: 1-channel 8MP@30 fps; 1-channel 5MP@30 fps; 2-channel 4MP@30 fps; 4-channel 1080p@30 fps
General.Video: Smart H.265+; H.265; Smart H.264+; H.264; MJPEG
General.Network Protocol: HTTP; HTTPS; TCP/IP; IPv4; RTSP; UDP; NTP; DHCP; DNS; SMTP; UPnP; IP Filter; DDNS; Alarm Server; IP Search (Supports Dahua IP camera, DVR, NVS, etc.); P2P;Auto Registration
General.Interoperability: ONVIF (profile T; profile S; profile G); CGI; SDK
General.Record Mode: Manual record; alarm recordings; motion detection recordings; scheduled recordings
General.Playback Function: 1. Play; pause; stop; fast forward; fast backward; rewind; play by frame 2. Full screen; backup (vide clip/file); partially zom in; audio on/off
General.General Alarm: Motion detection; privacy masking; video loss; PIR alarm; IPC alarm
General.Anomaly Alarm: Camera offline; storage error; disk full; IP conflict; MAC conflict; login lock; cyber security exception
General.Intelligent Alarm: Face detection; face recognition; perimeter protection (intrusion and tripwire); IVS; SMD Plus
General.Alarm Linkage: Recording; snapshot; buzzer; log; preset; email; tour
General.HDD: 1 SATA port, up to 10 TB. The maximum HDD capacity varies with environment temperature
General.Power Consumption: Total output of NVR is ≤ 10W (without HDD)Total output power of PoE is 72W, the maximum output power of asingle port is 25.5W
